topic: Liquid O2 system, O2 charging procedure
syllabus_extract: Liquid O2 system, O2 charging procedure
specific_objectives: 23.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the need of oxygen systems, types of systems, working principles of components.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of O2 charging procedure diagrams and safety checklists; Instructor supervision of theoretical walkthrough only.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of the aircraft oxygen system?
Name two types of oxygen systems used in aviation.
Why is liquid oxygen preferred over compressed gas for certain aircraft?

topics: Need for oxygen systems in aircraft
Working principle of liquid oxygen storage
Components of the liquid oxygen system
development.content:
Need for oxygen systems in aircraft
Types of oxygen systems available
Working principle of liquid oxygen storage
Components of the liquid oxygen system
Safety considerations for liquid oxygen

O2 charging procedure steps
Pre-charging safety checks
Monitoring pressure and temperature
Post-charging verification
Common errors during charging

Emergency response to O2 leaks
Maintenance requirements for O2 systems
Documentation and record keeping
Role of crew during charging
Final safety briefing

summary_questions: Explain the working principle of the liquid oxygen system.
List the key safety precautions during the O2 charging procedure.
Describe the steps involved in post-charging verification.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the maintenance and servicing requirements of the O2 system, referencing the safety precautions discussed in the next lesson plan (LP 27).

pft_rows.syllabus: Maintenance of O2 system, servicing and safety precautions. Safety measures while handling /upkeep of gaseous oxygen system. Quality checks on pressurized gas cylinders.
